comment: Reproduction parameters for the vertical short in this repo. The source trailer is the official Rockstar Games GTA VI Trailer 2 (May 2025). The chosen moment is the prison pickup scene where Jason Duval asks for Lucia Camino (dialogue: 'I'm here for Lucia Camino. She's supposed to be getting out. What's your name? Jason Duval.'). The frame is laid out as a blur-fill vertical: the full 1920x1080 trailer frame is scaled to fit 1080 wide (no horizontal content cut) and centered over a blurred, darkened fill so nothing important is cropped away.

cut.why: Scene runs from the golden-hour prison approach (~46s transition point, verified by per-frame luma) until the fade to the 'ROCKSTAR GAMES PRESENTS' card (fade begins ~69.3s). Dialogue 'I'm here for Lucia Camino' lands at ~52s and the reunion 'Hey.' at ~68s.

output.layout: blur-fill: full trailer frame scaled to 1080x608, centered at y=656; background is the frame scaled to 1080x1920, gblur sigma=45, darkened -0.08

text_lines.text: Make clips like this with AI

text_style.safe_area: All text is in the vertical safe area: away from the right-edge action buttons (y 900-1500 at x>880) and the bottom title/description overlay (y>1620).

footage.note: Footage is NOT committed to this repo. main.ts only renders when one of these candidate paths exists.

ffmpeg.filter_complex: [0:v]split=2[bg][fg];[bg]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,gblur=sigma=45,eq=brightness=-0.08[bgb];[fg]scale=1080:-2[fgs];[bgb][fgs]overlay=0:656[v0];[v0]drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSans-Bold.ttf:text='GTA 6\: how Jason met Lucia':fontsize=58:fontcolor=white:borderw=3:bordercolor=black@0.9:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.45:boxborderw=16:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=250:enable='between(t,0,5.5)',drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSans-Bold.ttf:text='GTA VI Trailer 2':fontsize=44:fontcolor=white:borderw=3:bordercolor=black@0.9:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.45:boxborderw=16:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=250:enable='between(t,5.5,11.5)',drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSans-Bold.ttf:text='Make clips like this with AI':fontsize=54:fontcolor=white:borderw=3:bordercolor=black@0.9:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5:boxborderw=18:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=1360:enable='between(t,11.5,17)',drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSans-Bold.ttf:text='and earn money on make.fun':fontsize=54:fontcolor=white:borderw=3:bordercolor=black@0.9:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5:boxborderw=18:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=1455:enable='between(t,11.5,17)',drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSans-Bold.ttf:text='make.fun/bounty/gta6-clipper-01':fontsize=52:fontcolor=white:borderw=3:bordercolor=black@0.9:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5:boxborderw=18:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=1408:enable='between(t,17,22.2)'[vout]
ffmpeg.note: bitexact + single-threaded encode + fixed creation_time make two runs write byte-identical MP4s. Explicit -f mp4 lets the temp .part output file be muxed as MP4.
